Labware for the technique (PCR setup): 1 finding.
1. WARNING LABWARE-FOR-TECHNIQUE: The wrong kind of plate: NEST 96 Well Plate 200 µL Flat is
  a flat plate, and PCR setup needs a PCR plate or PCR strips
   line 129:  p300.dispense(23, reaction_well)
   The plate map says the technique is PCR setup, which needs a PCR plate or PCR strips as
     its destination. The protocol delivers into NEST 96 Well Plate 200 µL Flat (slot 3,
     load name nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat), which is a flat plate. A thermocycler block is
     drilled for thin-walled 0.2 ml PCR wells; a flat plate does not fit in it, so the
     reaction can never be run. The plate map checks what each well holds, not what plate it
     is.
   Affected: wells A1, A10, A11, A12, A2, A3, A4, A5 and 40 more in slot 3.
   Fix: Load nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt (or the 200 ul PCR plate, or PCR strips
     on the aluminium block) as the destination; a flat plate cannot go in a thermocycler.
   Source: Opentrons, module setup: no error for an unusual labware and module combination
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/modules/setup.html
   Source: Opentrons, thermocycler: takes the 200 ul full-skirt PCR plate
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/modules/thermocycler.html
   Source: ABC-Bench (Liu et al. 2026): wrong labware identifiers, the commonest LLM error
           https://arxiv.org/html/2606.11150v1
   [2b6266719aff]

labware.explanation: The plate map says the technique is PCR setup, which needs a PCR plate or PCR strips as its destination. The protocol delivers into NEST 96 Well Plate 200 µL Flat (slot 3, load name nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat), which is a flat plate. A thermocycler block is drilled for thin-walled 0.2 ml PCR wells; a flat plate does not fit in it, so the reaction can never be run. The plate map checks what each well holds, not what plate it is.
labware.fix: Load nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt (or the 200 ul PCR plate, or PCR strips on the aluminium block) as the destination; a flat plate cannot go in a thermocycler.

sources.name: Opentrons, module setup: no error for an unusual labware and module combination

protocol.py: 5 biology problems (3 warnings, 2 notes).

1. WARNING COLD-MODULE-NEVER-SET: A temperature module was loaded but never set
   line 64:  p300.aspirate(240, component_block["A1"])
   At line 64 the robot draws from wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5 and A6 in slot 4, on a
   temperature module that the protocol never sets. A temperature module stays at room
   temperature until `set_temperature` is called, so buffer (carrier), dntp (reagent), fwd
   primer (reagent), polymerase (reagent) and 2 more sat on a block that was never cold; the
   robot pipetted there 8 times over the run. The person setting up the deck sees a module
   and assumes it is cold. Wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5 and A6 in slot 4.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5 and A6 in slot 4.
   Fix: Call `temp_module.set_temperature(4)` before the first transfer from Opentrons 24
   Well Aluminum Block with NEST 1.5 mL Snapcap in slot 4, and `temp_module.deactivate()` at
   the end.
   Source: Opentrons, temperature module: at room temperature until set_temperature, which
   blocks
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/modules/temperature_module.html
   Source: Thermo Fisher T4 ligase manual: keep on ice, use within minutes
           https://documents.thermofisher.com/TFS-Assets/LSG/manuals/t4dnaligase_1U_man.pdf
   Source: NEB: Q5 High-Fidelity PCR kit manual (add the polymerase last)
           https://www.neb.com/-/media/nebus/files/manuals/manuale0555.pdf
   [64d25f6da49b]

2. WARNING ENZYME-BEFORE-DILUENT: An enzyme was added before the water: polymerase
   line 77:  p20.dispense(12, reservoir["A1"])
   At line 77 the robot put polymerase into well A1 in slot 5. Take well A1 in slot 5: at
   that moment it held 464 ul, only 240 ul of it water or buffer, and the water came
   afterwards, at line 96, to make the 948 ul of water or buffer the reaction is built on.
   An enzyme is shipped in 50% glycerol and is meant to be the last thing into a reaction,
   after the water and the buffer have brought the well to the right dilution. Dropped into
   neat buffer or a dry well it meets many times the salt it should: a restriction enzyme
   then cuts at the wrong places (star activity) and a polymerase starts on mis-primed
   template.
   Affected: well A1 in slot 5.
   Fix: Reorder the additions to well A1 in slot 5: water and buffer first, then the sample,
   then polymerase last. Or make a master mix of water, buffer and enzyme in one tube, mix
   it, and hand it out.
   Source: Thermo Fisher: restriction enzyme key considerations (the enzyme is the final
   component)
           https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/life-science/cloning/cloning-learning-center/invitrogen-school-of-molecular-biology/molecular-cloning/restriction-enzymes/restriction-enzyme-key-considerations.html
   Source: Promega: restriction enzyme resource (add the enzyme last; glycerol and star
   activity)
           https://www.promega.com/resources/guides/nucleic-acid-analysis/restriction-enzyme-resource/
   Source: NEB: Q5 High-Fidelity PCR kit manual (add the polymerase last)
           https://www.neb.com/-/media/nebus/files/manuals/manuale0555.pdf
   Source: Qiagen: critical factors for successful real-time PCR (order of addition)
           https://www.gene-quantification.de/qiagen-qpcr-sample-assay-tech-guide-2010.pdf
   [6ad7baf33eee]

3. WARNING MIX-BEFORE-DRAW: Liquid drawn from well A1 in slot 5 before it was mixed: added
at line 106, drawn at line 128
   line 106:  p300.dispense(108, reservoir["A1"])
   At line 106 liquid was added to well A1 in slot 5, which already held a different liquid.
   At line 128 liquid was drawn out of it again, and the well was never mixed in between.
   Two liquids layered in a small well do not mix on their own, so what the tip drew is not
   at the concentration you calculated. In a dilution series every later step inherits the
   error.
   Affected: well A1 in slot 5.
   Also reached 48 other wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 40 more in slot 3.
   Fix: Mix the well after the addition at line 106: `mix_after=(5, volume)` in a transfer,
   or `pipette.mix(5, volume, well)`. Integra suggests about 5 cycles at about 80% of the
   volume in the well.
   Source: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applicationguide/master-art-pipetting-and-learn-how-perform-serial-dilutions-our-comprehensive-guide
   Source: Svec et al. 2015: how good is a PCR efficiency estimate
           https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4822216/
   [74ec2047883a]

4. NOTE NO-NEGATIVE-CONTROL: No no-template control: 48 wells of dntp and polymerase with a
sample
   line 129:  p300.dispense(23, reaction_well)
   At line 129 the robot starts putting dntp and polymerase into NEST 96 Well Plate 200 µL
   Flat (slot 3), and 48 wells end holding it together with a sample. No well on this plate
   holds the mix without a sample, so there is no no-template control. If a reagent is

   Source: Bio-Rad real-time PCR applications guide: controls in triplicate
           https://www.bio-rad.com/webroot/web/pdf/lsr/literature/Bulletin_5279.pdf
   Source: Thermo Maxima SYBR manual: the NTC contains all components except template DNA
           https://assets.fishersci.com/TFS-Assets/LSG/manuals/MAN0012933_Maxima_SYBR_Green_qPCR_Master_ROX_Sol__k0251_UG.pdf
   [4227ef78b681]

5. NOTE UNMIXED-AT-END: 48 wells never mixed after template 1, template 2, template 3,
template 4 and 44 more went in (8% of the well)
   line 136:  p20.dispense(2, reaction_well)
   At line 136 the robot added template 1, template 2, template 3, template 4 and 44 more to
   wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 40 more in slot 3, which already held dummy,
   buffer, dntp, polymerase and 3 more (this line did it 48 times). The addition was 8% of
   the well, nothing mixed the well afterwards, and the run ended with them that way. Two
   liquids layered in a small well do not mix on their own, so what the well holds is not at

   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 40 more in slot 3.
